name: Dong Xue
source:
Winter snow is a game about love on campus. Heterosexual students with different personalities are secretly in love with the flourishing male host. In choosing to communicate with a certain person, the male host is only left, love her or give her love.

Winter snow, different people, different choices, different stories, different suns!
translation:
冬雪是一款关于校园爱情的游戏。性格各异的异性恋学生，都暗恋着如日中天的男主。在选择与某个人交往时，男主就只剩下，爱她，还是给她爱。

冬天的雪，不同的人，不同的选择，不同的故事，不同的阳光！
